text.lead: Streetlight Harmonies is a 2017 documentary film directed by Brent Wilson. It had its world premiere at the 2017 DOC NYC Film Festival. It was released digitally through Gravitas Ventures and home video on March 31, 2020.
text.plot: The film tells the stories of the birth and evolution of Doo-Wop music.

- Charlie Thomas as himself

text.reception:
Critical response:
On Rotten Tomatoes, the documentary holds an approval rating of 100% based on 9 reviews, with an average rating of 7.8/10.
